receipt.public_excerpt: This past year, organizations released 149 foundation models, more than double the number released in 2022. Of these newly released models, 65.7% were open-source

evidence_items.explanation: Supply of foundation models more than doubled in 2023 and most were open-source, consistent with LLMs spreading toward commodity status.

evidence_items.locator: section But At a Cost of Performance?

receipt.public_excerpt: Closed-source models still outperform their open-sourced counterparts. On 10 selected benchmarks, closed models achieved a median performance advantage of 24.2%

evidence_items.explanation: In 2023, leading closed models such as OpenAI's kept a large measured lead, so frontier LLMs were not yet interchangeable commodities.

receipt.public_excerpt: LLaMA-13B outperforms GPT-3 (175B) on most benchmarks, and LLaMA-65B is competitive with the best models, Chinchilla-70B and PaLM-540B. We release all our models to the research community.

evidence_items.explanation: Weeks after the post, Meta released models that beat GPT-3 on most benchmarks. This supports quick replication of earlier OpenAI capability by others.

receipt.public_excerpt: OpenAI was currently generating around $80 million a month

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI's fast revenue growth in 2023 suggests its products were not yet priced as commodities, but revenue is an indirect measure.
